# ferriskey_email_template (Resource)

Manages an email template within a FerrisKey realm. Template import/export is not managed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_email_template" "reset" {
  realm      = "acme"
  name       = "Password reset"
  email_type = "reset_password"

  structure = jsonencode({
    children = [{
      type = "mj-section"
      children = [{
        type    = "mj-text"
        content = "Hello {{user.first_name}}, reset your password: {{reset_link}}"
      }]
    }]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email_type` (String) Email the template applies to: `reset_password`, `magic_link` or `email_verification`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Template name.
- `realm` (String) Name of the realm the template belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `structure` (String) Template body as a JSON document (use `jsonencode`), shaped like `{"children": [{"type": "mj-section", ...}]}`. Node types must be `mj-*` elements. The server sanitizes node content, so sanitized values show up as drift.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier `{realm}/{uuid}`.
- `mjml` (String) MJML markup rendered by the server from `structure`.
- `template_id` (String) Server-assigned UUID of the template.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ferriskey_email_template.reset acme/4b2d7f90-1111-2222-3333-444455556666
```
